name: Almond Milk
ingredients_raw: WATER, ALMOND PASTE (#4.5%), OLIGOFRUCTOSE (DIETARY FIBER) (#0.5%), MINERAL (TRICALCIUM PHOSPHATE), EMULSIFIERS (460 (i), 466), IODIZED SALT, ACIDITY REGULATOR (500 (ii)), STABILIZER (415), MINERAL (ZINC SULPHATE), VITAMIN E (ACETATE), VITAMIN A (ACETATE), VITAMIN B1 (THIAMINE MON NITRATE), VITAMIN B2 (RIBOFLAVIN) AND VITAMIN B12 (CYANOCOBALAMIN) ALLERGEN INFORMATION: CONTAINS NUT
